title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
lineage: Recording from front row, 15' from stage, mic attached to top of lean-to tent

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show highlighted by a smoking Wharf Rat jam and solid set; recording is decent digital source though not lossless.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the inspired jam into Wharf Rat – dubbed “Franklin’s fire” – and note that the band stayed on fire even as rain fell, with the keyboardist keeping the vibe alive. The audio is acceptable for streaming, but reviewers wish it were available in a loss‑less format.

ai_rating.rationale: Three consistently high ratings (5, 4, 5) and enthusiastic comments about the performance outweigh the lack of detailed recording‑quality feedback; overall impression is a great show with decent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No major sound complaints; reviewers appreciate the convenience of MP3/OGG but express desire for lossless formats, indicating the current source is acceptable but not optimal.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Even with rain interrupting the set, the band kept momentum; strong keyboard work and high energy carried the performance forward.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Reviewer exchanged a nod with Jerry, highlighting his presence on stage.
band_member_comments.Bob: Reviewer exchanged a nod with Bob (Bobby), indicating engagement.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboardist kept the vibe alive by playing through the rain.
